title: New York Polaroids 1976–1989
dimensions: 275 x 190 mm (Beaux Books; axis order not stated)

description.main: A diary in Polaroids of the downtown New York scene from 1976 to 1989 by Edo Bertoglio. Yard Press, 2015.
description.extended:
A diary in Polaroids of downtown New York between 1976 and 1989 by the Swiss photographer Edo Bertoglio.

The 232 pages mix snapshots of daily life, parties and views with portraits of friends and figures of the scene. They include Arto Lindsay, Grace Jones, Maripol, Glenn O'Brien, Debbie Harry, Madonna, Andy Warhol and John Lurie. Mariuccia Casadio contributes an essay, and an excerpt from an interview between Stefano Bianchi and the photographer is included. Yard Press published it in Rome in 2015 in an edition of 500 copies, bound in simulated leather with an image pasted to the front board.

Bertoglio was born in Lugano in 1951 and worked as a photographer and director. He arrived in New York in the fall of 1976 with his then-wife and collaborator Maripol, and photographed at CBGB, Studio 54 and Club 57.
